title: Reusable toggle function block
summary: Write the logic once and use it twice. The function block Toggle flips its output at each press; two instances drive Lamp1 and Lamp2 independently. A function Both lights Lamp3 when both lamps are on.
objectives: Write a FUNCTION_BLOCK with inputs, outputs and internal memory
Use two instances of the same function block, each with its own state
Write and call a FUNCTION that returns a value
starterProgram:
(* A reusable toggle: each press of Press flips On. *)
FUNCTION_BLOCK Toggle
VAR_INPUT
    Press : BOOL; (* The pushbutton. *)
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    On : BOOL; (* The toggled state. *)
END_VAR
VAR
    Edge : R_TRIG;
END_VAR

(* Flip On at each rising edge of Press. *)

END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

PROGRAM Main
VAR_INPUT
    Button1 : BOOL; (* Pushbutton S1, normally open. *)
    Button2 : BOOL; (* Pushbutton S2, normally open. *)
    AutoMode : BOOL; (* Selector S3 in position AUTO. *)
    PartPresent : BOOL; (* Proximity sensor B1 detects a part. *)
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    Lamp1 : BOOL; (* Green lamp H1. *)
    Lamp2 : BOOL; (* Amber lamp H2. *)
    Lamp3 : BOOL; (* Red lamp H3. *)
END_VAR
VAR
    Toggle1 : Toggle; (* One instance for S1 and H1. *)
    Toggle2 : Toggle; (* One instance for S2 and H2. *)
END_VAR

(* Call Toggle1 for Button1/Lamp1 and Toggle2 for Button2/Lamp2.
   Write FUNCTION Both and use it: Lamp3 := Both(Lamp1, Lamp2); *)

END_PROGRAM
instructions: Complete FUNCTION_BLOCK Toggle: each rising edge of Press flips On; holding Press flips it only once.
Call instance Toggle1 with Button1 and write its On to Lamp1. Call instance Toggle2 with Button2 and write its On to Lamp2.
Write FUNCTION Both : BOOL with inputs A and B that returns A AND B.
hints: The R_TRIG instance Edge inside Toggle gives one pulse per press: Edge(CLK := Press);
IF Edge.Q THEN On := NOT On; END_IF;
Each instance keeps its own Edge and On, so Toggle1 and Toggle2 do not affect each other.
A function assigns its result to its own name: Both := A AND B;
Open the Library tab of the inspector to see the signatures of Toggle and Both after a successful build.

scenarios.title: Switch on both lamps, then one off

criteria.title: The first press switches Lamp1 on
criteria.onFail: Lamp1 was off after the first press of S1.

criteria.title: The second press switches Lamp1 off
criteria.onFail: Lamp1 stayed on after the second press of S1.

criteria.title: The instances are independent
criteria.onFail: Lamp2 switched on although only S1 was pressed. Each lamp needs its own instance of Toggle.

criteria.title: Holding S1 flips Lamp1 only once
criteria.onFail: Lamp1 did not stay on while S1 was held. Toggle on the rising edge, not on the level.

criteria.title: One lamp alone does not light Lamp3
criteria.onFail: Lamp3 was on with only Lamp1 on. Both must return A AND B.

criteria.title: Both lamps on light Lamp3
criteria.onFail: Lamp3 was off although Lamp1 and Lamp2 were on.

criteria.title: Lamp3 goes off with Lamp2
criteria.onFail: Lamp3 stayed on after Lamp2 was switched off.
